name: ascii-dissolve
title: ASCII Dissolve
description: The frame turns into plain text: a field of monospace characters rises over the outgoing scene, flows as living ASCII, then dissolves cell by cell into the incoming scene. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .asd-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: A short glitchy cover transition with a typographic texture.
avoidWhen: Warm, human or premium brand pieces.
Scenes where the character grid would feel noisy.
author: Remocn
